name: me? on a date with KAZUHA?!
source:
You wake up one day, who knows where the hell you are. The only thing you have on you is your phone. In fact, it's chiming right now! "Kazuha," it reads. Huh. The only Kazuha you know is Kazuha Kaedehara from Genshin Impact, the anime boy you spent $1000 dollars in whaling for. It can't be, right? But it fucking is. You're on a date with Kazuha Kaedehara. 

"me? on a date with KAZUHA?!" is a fan made [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genshin_Impact]Genshin Impact[/url] visual novel.

[From [url=https://xaea-xii.itch.io/kazuha]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天你醒来，谁知道你到底在哪里。你身上唯一的东西就是你的手机。事实上，它现在正在鸣响！“Kazuha”，上面写着。呵呵。你唯一认识的Kazuha是《Genshin Impact》中的Kazuha Kaedehara，他是你花了1000美元去捕鲸的动漫男孩。不可能吧？但他妈的是。你正在和枫原一叶约会。

“我？和一叶约会？！”是粉丝制作的 [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Genshin_Impact]Genshin Impact[/url] 视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://xaea-xii.itch.io/kazuha]Itch.io[/url]]
